title: M-PAM Modulator Baseband
text: 使用 M 元脉冲幅度调制进行调制，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Output data type} 指定输出数据类型；{M-ary number} 指定调制阶数、{Input type} 指定输入值类型、{Constellation ordering} 指定符号的映射顺序、{Normalization method} 指定星座的缩放方法 Min. distance between、{Minimum distance} 指定两个最近星座点之间的距离、{Average power, referenced to 1 ohm (watts)} 指定平均功率、{Peak power, referenced to 1 ohm (watts)} 指定最大功率、{View Constellation} 绘制参考星座的选项，按实例取值。

ports.name: In
ports.summary: 输入信号 scalar | column vector

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: M-PAM 调制的基带信号 scalar | column vector

params.name: M-ary number
params.values: 调制阶数 4 (default) | positive, even integer

params.name: Constellation ordering
params.values: 符号的映射顺序 Binary (default) | Gray

params.name: Normalization method
params.values: 星座的缩放方法 Min. distance between symbols (default) | Average Power | Peak Power

params.name: Minimum distance
params.values: 两个最近星座点之间的距离 2 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: View Constellation
params.values: 绘制参考星座的选项 button

params.name: Output data type
params.values: 输出数据类型 double (default) | single | fixdt(1,16) | fixdt(1,16,0) | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation |
